deck.name: Impeccable 4.0 — Decision Flight Recorder
deck.reference_design: A decision flight recorder: signal tracks, numbered states, instrument-readout evidence, and explicit commitment gates

waivers.IMAGE_LOW_DPI: The supplied 640x360 video is the highest-fidelity authentic source; only three proof slides use frames and each is inspected in a real PowerPoint render.
waivers.TEXT_TOO_SMALL: Only evidence labels, folios, matrix labels, and secondary metadata fall below 11pt; primary claims and explanations remain presentation scale.
waivers.TEXT_LOW_CONTRAST: The linter does not consistently resolve colored-field backgrounds. Real PowerPoint render inspection is the authority for primary readability.
waivers.TEXT_OVERFLOW_RISK: Real PowerPoint renders confirm the compact analytical labels render without clipping or collisions.
waivers.TEXT_BOX_OVERLAP: The linter treats intentionally adjacent title/subtitle and staircase-label regions as material overlaps. The 1920x1080 PowerPoint render confirms all flagged regions are visually separated and readable.
waivers.SLIDE_WORD_COUNT: Dense analytical slides preserve only the decision logic needed for executive review; the real render confirms legible spacing.
waivers.DECK_COLOR_COUNT: The count includes antialiasing and embedded source-frame colors; the native system uses five governed roles.
